infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FitCheck uses your camera to take the selfies that build your avatar. Photos stay on your device until you create an avatar, and are never used for training.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FitCheck can pick selfies from your library to build your avatar, and save your fit checks back to it.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: FitCheck saves your fit check images to your photo library when you ask it to.

plugins.cameraPermission: FitCheck uses your camera to take the selfies that build your avatar.

plugins.savePhotosPermission: FitCheck saves your fit check images to your photo library when you ask it to.
